title: 9tz.6: Tests for TantivySearchIndex
description:
What: Write test suite for TantivySearchIndex using independent oracles.

Oracle: Known article content hand-authored in test; search terms are chosen to be present or absent by inspection. Not derived from the code under test.

Test cases:
1. index_then_search_body: index article with body 'hello rust world', search_in_group('rust') → finds article_num; search_in_group('python') → empty.
2. index_then_search_subject: index article with subject 'Tantivy test', search for 'tantivy' → finds it (case-insensitive).
3. query_too_long_returns_error: query_str of 5000 bytes → SearchError::QueryTooLong.
4. search_respects_newsgroup: index two articles in different groups; search in group A finds only A's article.
5. commit_is_needed: index an article, do NOT commit, open a new searcher → zero results; after commit → one result.
6. body_truncation: index article with body longer than body_index_max_bytes; confirm indexing succeeds and no panic.

All tests use open_in_memory(), never touch disk.

Defensive rules: Tests must have independent oracles (hand-crafted values). Tests must not use the code under test as its own oracle. No search result fed back into the indexer as a query.
